lines.text: How's the wrist been since the cast came off?
Since last time it's much less swollen, but it's still stiff bending it back.
Sorry, one second, that's my phone. Hello? Yes, I'm with someone, I'll ring you back at half past. Bye now.
Sorry about that. Let me have a look. It bends back about forty degrees, the good side does seventy.
Prayer stretch against the kitchen worktop, hold for thirty seconds, five times, every couple of hours.
Is there any numbness I should watch for? My fingers went a bit funny in the cast.
If your fingers go numb or the hand turns cold and pale, come straight back in.
